Contact Creation Restriction

The Contact Creation Restriction module for Odoo is designed to enhance data control and integrity by preventing the creation of new contact records across the system. By disabling the “Create” option for both users and administrators, this module ensures that only pre-approved contacts are used in business operations.



  • Features
  • Screenshots
  • Support
  • Service

Features

Global Restriction on Contact Creation

This module introduces a system-wide control that disables the ability to create new contact records for both users and administrators. Once activated, the “Create” button is removed from all relevant views, ensuring that no new contacts can be added manually.

Configurable Restriction via Boolean Setting

A dedicated boolean field, Partner Creation Restriction, allows easy activation or deactivation of the restriction. Users with appropriate access can toggle this setting to control whether contact creation is allowed.

Screenshot

1.) User Settings - Partner Creation Restriction

A new option becomes available within user settings, allowing activation of the Partner Creation Restriction.



2.) Contacts Kanban View - Restricted Access

The contact management interface in kanban format reflects the restriction by removing the option to add new entries.



3.) Contacts List View - No Create Option

Within the list view of contacts, the absence of the create functionality ensures consistency across different layouts.



4.) Contact Form View - Creation Disabled

The contact form no longer provides an option to initiate new entries once the restriction is active.



5.) Sales/Quotation Flow - Creation Blocked

While working on quotations or sales orders, attempts to create a new customer directly from the selection field are prevented.
